episodes.title: Dusty
episodes.summary: Family man and teacher Dusty Hubbard begins to reevaluate his life and happiness after the arrival of a strange machine called the Morpho.

episodes.title: Cass
episodes.summary: Dusty and Cass host a dinner as she wrestles with what her Morpho card might mean. Deerfield's citizens start making drastic life changes.

episodes.title: Jacob
episodes.summary: As the town prepares for Deerfield High's homecoming basketball game, Jacob is encouraged to step into his brother's shoes.

episodes.title: Father Reuben
episodes.summary: A Morpho-inspired wedding leads to celebration. Father Reuben struggles with the machine's growing influence.

episodes.title: Trina
episodes.summary: Despite her feelings of guilt, Trina celebrates Jacob's birthday at the Kovac house. Dusty and Cass visit a themed hotel for a romantic getaway.

episodes.title: Beau
episodes.summary: Beau searches for the boy who wronged Kolton. Dusty takes over as the basketball coach. Cass pursues a new business venture.

episodes.title: Giorgio
episodes.summary: The Potential Fund gala gives Giorgio an opportunity to get closer to Cass. Dusty comes to a realization.

episodes.title: Izzy
episodes.summary: Izzy opens up to Cass about her past. Dusty confronts Giorgio. Mr. Johnson's magic show sets the stage for shocking revelations.

episodes.title: Deerfest: Part One
episodes.summary: Cass and Dusty deal with the fallout from the magic show. Trina comes clean about Jacob. An approaching storm threatens Deerfield.

episodes.title: Deerfest: Part Two
episodes.summary: Season finale. Father Reuben makes a discovery about Hana. Dusty and Cass contemplate their future. The Morpho reveals a new mystery.

episodes.title: The Next Stage
episodes.summary: Hana reveals what she knows about the Morpho, as the rest of the town tries to get to the next stage.

episodes.title: Visions
episodes.summary: Dusty and Cass make a big decision about their relationship. Trina and Jacob throw a house party.

episodes.title: Power & Energy
episodes.summary: Dusty's dinner with a colleague takes a romantic turn. Cass sets out on a night to herself. Trina and Jacob empty Kolton's locker.

episodes.title: Storytellers
episodes.summary: Cass, Nat, and Hana grow closer. Dusty struggles with the repercussions of his date. Mr. Johnson confronts a painful memory.

episodes.title: Night Under the Stars
episodes.summary: Dusty and the boys host a school event at Giorgio's restaurant. Cass, Nat, and Hana have a girls' night out.

episodes.title: Back in the Saddle
episodes.summary: After receiving his vision, Beau decides to start dating again. Izzy attempts to impress a physical therapist. Dusty and Cass dogsit.

episodes.title: Rehearsals
episodes.summary: On her first date with Freya, Izzy has an awkward run-in with Cass. Dusty volunteers to direct the school play.

episodes.title: Our Town
episodes.summary: Deerfield High adds a twist to its production of Our Town. Giorgio helps Father Reuben with Hana. Dusty and Cass second-guess their separation.

episodes.title: Un-Selfploration
episodes.summary: The town prepares for the Deercoming Parade. Beau fulfills a secret dream. Trina and Jacob take their relationship to the next level.

episodes.title: Deercoming
episodes.summary: Season finale. With the parade underway, Dusty searches for the Guide. Hana and Father Reuben make a surprising discovery.
